note: D14: V2 exclusion text rules used to substring-match, so the EDITED_EDITOR rule ('editor') fired inside the word 'editors' and isExcludedText dropped the whole EditedL3 chunk 'Edited by the editors' — losing real edited evidence whose date arrives via parent context (score 20+10+5 = edited_show 35). V1 exclusions are whole-token (D6 shared matcher) and keep the verdict; the V2 engine must not diverge. 'editorial' is deliberately absent from the body: it is itself a listed exclusion rule.
